capabilities: Discover HTML files in configured vault folders
Render HTML pages inside Obsidian with back and shelf navigation
Filter pages by title, path, and section
Follow relative links between HTML pages
Curate shelf listings with optional html-shelf.json manifests
disambiguation: Not an HTML editor, exporter, or web-clipper; it only browses and renders HTML files already stored in the vault.
extras: README warns that vault HTML is treated as untrusted: scripts, frames, and remote stylesheets are stripped before rendering, but remote images, CSS url() fetches, and referenced local CSS can still make network requests, so review HTML from untrusted sources. Also documents that Obsidian Sync does not sync .html/.htm by default and requires enabling selective sync per device.
problem: HTML files are missing from Obsidian's file explorer on mobile and otherwise open in an external browser instead of alongside notes.
summary: HTML file reader that discovers the .html and .htm files in a vault and renders them inside Obsidian on mobile and desktop.
